limitations: Digitally validated geometry is not evidence of a successful physical print.

summary: A one-handed print-in-place desk toy whose captive moon runner follows one fully visible braided figure-eight route through two separated bridges and returns home by continued thumb motion.
title: Eclipse Braid
what_arrives: One assembled Eclipse Braid frame with a visible braided rail and captive moon runner.
One two-sided in-box guide for first use, reset, troubleshooting, care, and safety.
